text:
alex: small docs PR heads-up: clarifying compatibility notes for acadia-xl variants + adding an example showing quantized fallback and a short benchmark footnote. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4602
mira: good. please include explicit alias mapping e.g. `acadia-xl-quant` -> `acadia-xl-compat-q4_0` and call out that results vary by GPU family.
dan: can you add the SDK v4 snippet that uses client.models.resolveVariant and a one-line curl example? that'll help support tickets.
alex: added both. snippet is minimal, uses try/catch fallback to compat alias. also changed the model card key to `max_sequence_length` per style guide.
ci-bot: Preview build up: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.io/pr-4602 (CI #11680)
ops-lead: Ops note: hold off on deprecating old `acadia-lite` alias until next maintenance window. docs can show scheduled deprecation but we won't flip the banner yet.
mira: ack. i'll keep the banner behind a feature flag and include a TODO with the maintenance window date.
dan: tiny nit: in benchmarks section, prefer showing q4_0 vs fp16 at batch sizes 1 and 16 only to keep the table compact. add footnote "hardware and kernel selection affect throughput".
alex: done. merging plan: small edits now, wait for ops greenlight for banner flip. will open follow-up PR to sync model-catalog CSV for exact ceilings. thanks all!
